user_story:
As a user, I want to see the content loaded asynchronously after clicking the 'Start' button, so that I can verify that the page functions correctly. Acceptance Criteria: 
1. When I click the 'Start' button, I should see the content with ID 'finish' become visible. 
2. The URL should remain the same: 'https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/dynamic_loading/1'. 
3. The content with ID 'finish' should display the text 'Hello World!'.
